'''Bloodletting blades''' were used by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in clan rituals. These rituals could involve the sacrifice of animals, condemned sand people<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> or [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] such as [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]].
